witness.note: 074000 identifies the surviving 1522 Jiajing printing; its 1494 preface does not prove an unchanged complete novel in 1494. The later received 120-chapter Mao recension remains distinct.

period.note: The historical battle is explicitly dated; the surrounding narrative includes invented episodes and cannot be dated from this anchor alone.

creators.note: Work attribution; distinguish the received text and its transmission from a securely identified single historical author.

description: Recounts the novel's Red Cliffs alliance, court debates, rival advisers and elaborate deceptions, distinguishing literary stratagems from the historical battle and examining the coalition's survival, competing obligations and unresolved territorial rivalry.
